histogram.name: ResourceBroker.LifecycleEvent
histogram.summary: Recorded when discrete Resource Broker lifecycle milestones occur in the browser process: when the service is initially launched, and when the service is permanently disabled for the session due to a rapid crash loop (3 or more crashes within 10 minutes).

histogram.name: ResourceBroker.RoutingDecision{FrameType}
histogram.summary: Whether a subresource URLLoaderFactory is eligible for routing through the Cross-Renderer Resource Broker and, if not, the first reason it was excluded. Recorded once per untrusted, network-backed subresource factory created for a document {FrameType} while the ResourceBroker feature is enabled; non-network factories (e.g. data:/file:/filesystem: scheme handlers or WebUI with bindings) and browser-trusted factories (e.g. cross-origin prefetch) are not counted. Counts factories, not documents: a document can create several (e.g. for isolated worlds or factory updates), and a new tab's initial empty document also creates one (OpaqueOrigin in .MainFrame). Where strict site isolation is not enabled (notably on Android), unisolated sites share unlocked processes and report NotLockedToSite.
